integrity: Proof is self-contained; finite numerical spectra are supplementary, not infinite certification. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Unit-edge shortest-path geometry of finite \(K_s\) joined to disjoint nonempty cliques, \(s\ge2\) and at least two peripheral components; no result for arbitrary joins or weighted metrics. Special cases with one hub or only singleton peripheral components are previously treated in related literature and not separately asserted as novel. Historical priority remains subject to inaccessible or equivalent sources.
title: Sharp negative-type phase transition for clique-core books
